description:
Configure legally-required checkout agreements for the store. 

1. Enable the feature: Go to Stores > Configuration > Sales > Checkout > Checkout Options and set 'Enable Terms and Conditions' to 'Yes'. Save the configuration.

2. Create Agreement 1:
   - Navigate to Stores > Terms and Conditions
   - Name: 'Handmade Goods Terms of Service'
   - Status: Enabled
   - Applied: Manually
   - Store View: All Store Views
   - Checkbox Text: 'I agree to the Terms of Service for handmade goods'
   - Content (HTML): Must include an <h2> heading 'Terms of Service', explain items are 'handmade', mention shipping takes '2-4 weeks', and specify a '14 days' return window.

3. Create Agreement 2:
   - Name: 'Privacy and Data Policy'
   - Status: Enabled
   - Applied: Manually
   - Store View: All Store Views
   - Checkbox Text: 'I have read and agree to the Privacy and Data Policy'
   - Content (HTML): Must include an <h2> heading 'Privacy Policy', and mention 'data' collection and 'cookie' usage.

If not logged in, use admin / Admin1234!

agreement1.checkbox_text_partial: Terms of Service for handmade goods

agreement2.checkbox_text_partial: agree to the Privacy and Data Policy
